decision_lens: Prioritizes output interfaces that map to manuscript structure (chapters, sections) rather than pipeline details (chunk indices).
focus: Output display and navigation for reassembled chunked editorial results, including diff view and chapter-level navigation
name: fd-result-assembly-display
persona: A product designer with publishing and document UX background. Evaluates output against the mental model of an author reviewing editorial feedback on a 200-page manuscript.
review_areas: Whether the OutputPane can navigate by structural unit rather than by chunk index
How TrackChangesView performs when the input is 200K words — virtualization or pagination needed?
How per-chunk analysis results are aggregated into a manuscript-level summary
Whether VersionSelector scales to a manuscript context
How editorial annotations are anchored across chunk boundaries in reassembled output
What the skeleton state looks like as chunks complete — progressive or wait-for-all?
success_hints: Author can jump to chapter 7 without scrolling 150 pages
Manuscript-level quality signals visible without per-chunk inspection
Diff view readable and performant for 100K+ words
task_context: Texturaize processes editorial text through a pipeline worker on slse. Current UI uses TiptapEditor for paste input. Task extends this for 50K-250K word manuscripts.
